scheme_name: Coffee Development Programme in North Eastern Region: Expansion of Coffee
other_conditions: Applicant must be a tribal grower
Applicant’s land must be deemed suitable for coffee cultivation by Coffee Board officers
Seed material must be procured exclusively from the Coffee Board
benefits_summary: Subsidy of 50% of the unit cost (₹50,000 per hectare) payable in two installments.
documents_required: Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attested, if required)
